prompt: a single printed L-bracket, 40mm wide and 3mm thick, with a 30mm leg and a 25mm leg, and two M4 clearance holes through each leg
why: Single part with holes on two faces at right angles. G3 measures every hole's diameter and whether it passes through, so a hole drilled into the wrong leg, or bridged by the other leg's material at the inside corner, fails a probe. volumeFraction separates an L from the solid 30x40x25 block that contains it (a real L is about 0.2).
